id: title:dmarchuk:open the ai panel for broadcast email editing

review.posthog_relevance: Adds agent-specific state management and refresh actions to the Broadcast workflow wizard, enabling the workflow to update email steps after agent edits.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded implementation of agent-driven workflow state management. It adds a new async action (`refreshFromAgentEdit`) and a boolean flag to the Kea store, establishing the mechanism for the agent to trigger a broadcast state refresh. review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks the backend implementation, API, and complete agent invocation handling, so the end-to-end behavior and reliability of the agent workflow cannot be verified. The tier is assigned based on the visible frontend implementation, not the complete system behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the backend implementation of the workflows-patch-action-email tool, the workflow retrieval API, or the agent invocation and response handling. It also does not include the complete agent panel implementation or the complete workflow wizard. Therefore, while the frontend changes are substantial, the complete implementation and its behavior cannot be ded.
